LandingPage.hero_heading: Sailing Loc: Peer-to-peer boat rental in Europe
LandingPage.hero_tagline: The open sea in one click. Confidence as a bonus.
LandingPage.hero_summary: Rent a sailboat or motorboat from passionate owners in French and European ports. Secure booking, verified reviews, transparent commission.
LandingPage.hero_image_alt: Leisure sailboat available for rent at the port of Marseille
LandingPage.highlight_text: SailingLoc connects owners and renters for an authentic nautical experience. Publish your listing, manage availability and receive payments securely — we charge a 10% commission on each rental.
LandingPage.highlight_owner_text: List your boats, manage the calendar and contractual documents from your dedicated space.
LandingPage.highlight_renter_text: Search by port, dates and boat type. Book and pay online, then leave a review after your trip.
LandingPage.step_search_text: Filter by port, dates, boat type and budget to find the perfect vessel.
LandingPage.step_book_text: Pick your dates on the calendar, review the summary and pay online securely.
LandingPage.step_sail_text: Connect with the owner, board and enjoy your rental with peace of mind.
LandingPage.testimonial_1_quote: Excellent weekend aboard an impeccable sailboat. Online booking was simple and the owner was very responsive.
LandingPage.testimonial_2_quote: I rent my boat three seasons a year. The owner space lets me manage everything: calendar, documents and payments.
LandingPage.footer_disclaimer: Fictional student project: no real purchase or booking can be made
